subject: Dedicated capacity post-call recap — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity post-call recap — Aurora Health

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have the same page: 

Pain points you shared:
- 95th pct latency spikes on inference during morning peaks (~800-1200ms currently) impacting user experience.
- Strict data isolation requirement for PHI processing — must be VPC or on-prem with customer-managed keys.
- Need predictable unit economics for growth planning; current spend on bursty managed endpoints is unpredictable.

Goals we agreed on:
- Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) to guarantee throughput and isolation.
- SLO target: 99.95% availability for inference endpoints and p95 latency <250ms for typical chat flows (up to 512 tokens).
- Autoscale plan to support 2x traffic growth within 90 days of go-live.
- Start a 30-day pilot on a subset of workloads to validate latency/cost improvements.

Engineering constraints / requirements you mentioned:
- On-prem is preferred for Phase 2; for Phase 1 you want a VPC-private deployment in us-west-2 with customer KMS.
- Audit logs for token-level access retained for 12 months.

What Redwood will deliver (high-level):
- Reserved pool: initial recommendation 6x H100-equivalent GPUs (we gave two sizing options on the call).
- Isolated VPC deployment with BYOK (KMS) + SOC2 evidence for our control plane.
- Autoscaling policy that supports scheduled scale-ups during peak windows and a manual burst buffer.
- SLA proposal: 99.95% uptime for dedicated capacity and 95th pct request success (with rollback/fallback policy to hosted variants).

Next steps:
1) I will share a written proposal (attached) with the sizing options, pricing bands, and proposed timeline.
2) Marissa will follow up to schedule a 1hr technical review with your infra team to map network/KMS details.
3) Please share your procurement timeline and any required legal templates so we can fast-track redlines.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-proposal-aurora-v1.pdf (proposal + sizing), audit-sla-metrics.csv (sample SLO reporting)

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll correct. Otherwise, I’ll queue Marissa to set the technical deep-dive for next week.

Thanks —
Ben
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@aurorahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 24 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity post-call recap — Aurora Health

Thanks Ben — this looks right and captures the call well. A couple of clarifications / asks from our side:

- The p95 <250ms target is critical for the patient-facing chat workflows. Can you confirm whether that target assumes the KV cache and batching settings you mentioned on the call?
- For the pilot, we'd like to limit to 2 models initially (clinical triage and appointment assistant). We expect about 200 qps combined at peak for those two.
- Security: we will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an architecture diagram detailing the VPC peering and KMS flow. Can your team provide those as part of the onboarding packet?
- Procurement timeline: procurement + legal need roughly 3 weeks once we receive the proposal and standard SOW.

Marcus — looping you in for infra questions.

If you can provide the detailed sizing justification and confirm the SLO assumptions, we can aim to have legal start review next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Cloud Product
Aurora Health
priya.shah@aurorahealth.com | +1 (206) 555-0123

Hi Priya and Marcus —

Appreciate the quick response. A few clarifications and items attached: 

- p95 latency: the <250ms p95 target assumes KV prefix caching for session state and conservative batching (max batch size 8) for request patterns similar to your demo flows. We included the expected latency curve in page 4 of the attached proposal.
- Sizing: recommendation is 6x H100-equivalent for the pilot to meet 200 qps with headroom; if you take option B (8x H100) you get 2.5x headroom and longer runway for growth. See pricing table on page 2.
- Security artifacts: attached is our SOC 2 summary (redacted) and a network diagram stub. We can provide customer-specific architecture + KMS flow in the technical review.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-proposal-aurora-v1.pdf, audit-sla-metrics.csv

Suggested next meeting: Tech deep-dive with your infra + security and our DevOps (Marissa) — Wed, 27 May at 10am PT. Does that work?

Procurement note: I added the DocuSign placeholder link in the proposal so legal can preview the terms. I will also ask our contracts team to prepare a shortened SOW for pilot.

If you give a thumbs up on sizing we can lock pricing for 30 days and schedule the pilot kickoff.

Best,
Ben
